# slack-app_user (Data Source)

Looks up a Slack workspace user ID by email address using `users.lookupByEmail`. Requires the provider `bot_token` with the `users:read.email` scope.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The user's email address.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `user_id` (String) The Slack user ID.
